documented_requirement_or_gap: Stock/lifetime uncertainty changes time-indexed flows; deterministic service-life mappings can discard alternative realizations
S_DT_evidence: DTMFB-7b8729bf813b (10.1007/978-981-96-6657-7_7): component masses plus layer service lives to annual outflow CSV

proposed_structural_response: Couple uncertain inventory realizations with conditioned lifetime/turnover models and revise them when new event evidence arrives
compatibility_to_check: Censored lifetimes; age conditioning; competing interventions; update timing; correlated buildings/components; covariance may not capture non-Gaussian alternatives
remaining_gap: Generic online estimation is not a validated building-turnover DT implementation
